notes: Accuracy/reasoning benchmark for Aurora. UNLIKE the ARM benchmark (which scores research discipline on open-ended questions with no single right answer), every item here has ONE verifiable ground-truth answer, so accuracy is graded deterministically — no LLM judge, no API cost beyond the answers themselves. v0.2.0 hardened the set: the v0.1 questions were famous riddles a cheap model has memorized (it scored 100%, so the benchmark could not discriminate). These use off-the-shelf numbers, trap variants (CRT bat-and-ball, average-speed), and harder multi-step items (modular exponent, inclusion-exclusion, clock angle) chosen to actually separate models. Every answer was hand-verified. `type` drives matching: 'number' compares the extracted numeric value; 'text' compares the normalized string (with `accept` aliases). The model is told to end with `FINAL: <answer>`.

questions.prompt: A warehouse has 1,248 boxes. 3/8 of them are shipped on Monday, and 1/4 of the remaining boxes are shipped on Tuesday. How many boxes are left after Tuesday? Give the number.
A laptop is listed at $1,200. A store applies a 15% discount, then adds 8% sales tax on the discounted price. What is the final price in dollars?
Pipe A can fill a tank in 4 hours. Pipe B can fill the same tank in 12 hours. If both run together, how many hours does it take to fill the tank? Give the number of hours.
A bat and a ball cost $2.20 in total. The bat costs $2.00 more than the ball. How much does the ball cost, in cents?
January 1, 2025 falls on a Wednesday. On what day of the week does March 1, 2025 fall? (2025 is not a leap year.)
What is the remainder when 7 raised to the power 100 is divided by 5?
How many distinct arrangements are there of the letters in the word BANANA?
What is the next number in the sequence 2, 3, 5, 9, 17, ... ?
Sara buys 3 notebooks at $4.50 each and 2 pens at $1.25 each. She pays with a $20 bill. How much change does she get, in dollars?
Five years ago, Maria was three times as old as her son. Now she is twice as old as her son. How old is Maria now?
In a race, Tom finished ahead of Sam, Sam finished ahead of Lee, and Lee finished ahead of Raj. Who finished last? Answer with one name.
After a 20% discount, a jacket costs $96. What was its original price in dollars?
How many integers from 1 to 100 inclusive are divisible by 3 or by 5?
A rectangle has a perimeter of 36 cm and is twice as long as it is wide. What is its area in square centimeters?
All roses are flowers. Some flowers fade quickly. Therefore, some roses fade quickly. Is this conclusion logically valid? Answer yes or no.
A car travels 150 km at 50 km/h, then another 150 km at 75 km/h. What is the average speed for the whole trip, in km/h?
Two-thirds of a number is 18. What is three-quarters of that same number?
What is the angle, in degrees, between the hour hand and the minute hand of a clock at exactly 3:30?
